analysis_steps.goal: fit SZ + point-source model to visibilities

method.value: Bayesian forward modeling of raw visibilities with gNFW pressure model (fixed shape parameters) plus Dirac-delta point sources with flat spectrum

evidence.quote: we perform a Bayesian forward-modeling analysis directly on the visibilities of the ACA MaDCoWS sample

key_parameters.value: free: M500, z, centroid, point source positions and fluxes, flux normalization

evidence.quote: The position $\bm{x}_{\textsc{ps}}$ and the source flux $i_{\textsc{ps}}$ are left free to vary.

assumptions.value: non-relativistic tSZ, kSZ neglected, flat ΛCDM Ωm=0.30 H0=70

evidence.quote: we neglect any temperature-dependent corrections arising from the fully relativistic treatment of the thermal SZ effect

fitting.value: Normal priors on centroid (sigma 14.3, 15 arcsec); split-normal priors on z; normal prior on flux scaling; wide uninformative priors on point source flux

evidence.quote: we adopt split-normal priors (cite: Wallis2014) on the redshifts $z$

validation.value: data-free runs show no prior-induced biases

evidence.quote: have shown no biases in the parameter inference related to choice in the prior distributions

method.value: Bayes factor between SZ+point-source and point-source-only models, converted to sigma_eff
